tool_args.rationale: The observations show a concave substrate response suppressed by gradient. The proposed family fits a saturating substrate field and gradient-dependent sink numerically, using leave-one-out error to choose whether an additional conjunctive sink term is warranted. Fresh confirmation is needed to establish whether it meets the tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have already been acquired; the nine observations support fitting and testing a low-dimensional stationary model.
A substrate-only Haldane curve cannot explain the gradient dependence; a simple power law lacks the indicated saturating sink structure.
The observed gradients are below the stated supercritical range, so its threshold and avalanche coefficient are not identifiable from these rows.
